interface.name: enzui_text_commit_v1

description.summary: insert text alongside the seat's input method

interface.description: This privileged interface commits text into the enabled text-input-v3 target of the compositor's keyboard seat. It does not obtain an input method, observe field contents, or generate key events.

request.name: commit

description.summary: insert text at the current keyboard focus

request.description: Text must be nonempty UTF-8, at most 4000 bytes. With space_before set to 1, the compositor may add a space when the text would run into the preceding word. A value of 0 requests the exact text. The compositor replies once per request, in request order.

event.name: result

description.summary: whether the compositor sent the text

event.description: Sent is 1 if the compositor sent a commit to the enabled text input, or 0 if it could not deliver, including during an IME composition or while the session is locked.
